title: Three components of agent workflow automation
oneliner: Before building agent workflow automation, master its three parts: automated task execution, multi-agent coordination, and business process transformation.
says: If you are building AI agent workflow automation for your organization, consider three major components: automated task execution, multi-agent coordination, and business process transformation. Deep-dive all three before you build.
explained: The three components are deliberately ordered. Task execution is the floor - one agent reliably completing one task, with error handling and retries. Multi-agent coordination is the multiplier - agents handing work to each other with shared state, which is the whiteboard topic from his interview reel. Neither matters without the third: business process transformation, which asks whether the process itself should change now that steps run autonomously.

That last one is where most projects underdeliver. Automating the existing process step-for-step preserves its bottlenecks; transformation means redesigning the process around what agents do well - parallel work, instant handoffs, 24/7 operation - and what humans must still own. The orchestrator role from reel #28 is usually part of that redesign.
takeaway: Task execution, coordination, then process redesign - in that order of difficulty, and the third is where the real value is.
